integrity: The algebraic proof is self-contained relative to standard properties of finite group quotients, Apéry sets and additive covers; exact integer test code is supporting only. Scientific results from the cited work are acknowledged as such.
scientific_limitations: Only the distinguished point at infinity and odd-characteristic even-support quotients are treated. Full other-point semigroups, multipoint gaps and code distances are not calculated. Historical priority and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: The Weierstrass semigroup of scalar quotients of even-support additive curves
